name: Shlok Dubey
role: AI/ML Engineer and Full Stack Developer
tagline: One person, three agents: building, leading, learning.
intro: I'm an AI/ML engineer and full-stack developer in Bhopal. I ship multi-agent products for Indian users and lead a student council.
bio: I'm a final-year B.Tech student in Computer Science (AI & ML) at IES College of Technology, Bhopal. I build AI-powered products, mostly multi-agent systems and full-stack apps aimed at Indian problems and users.
Away from the keyboard I serve as President of the Student Council (2026–27) after a term as Vice President, and I've run INFORIA, our college fest, two years in a row.
